english:
Only usable while airborne after sprinting for 0.03 seconds (one game tick).

Performs a dive to the ground, dealing at least <pve 210 /> <pvp [65] /> damage to enemies within 8 meters of the impact site with no Damage Falloff. Damage increases with time spent falling; a diagonal slam from maximum jump height deals approximately <pve 1,000 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

Each enemy hit grants 3% Super Energy and 3 stacks of <arc Bolt Charge />.

You cannot perform a Melee Attack for 0.9 seconds after landing.

source.text:
While Airborne, after sprinting for 0.03 seconds:
Quickly descends and strikes the ground, dealing a minimum of 210 [65] damage with no falloff to enemies within 8 metres.
Grants 3% Super Energy and x3 Bolt Charge per enemy hit.
Damage scales with time spent falling. A maximum jump height diagonal slam deals ~1,000 damage
Cannot perform a Melee Attack within 0.9 seconds of landing.
Base Cooldown: 164.6 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.7x
